svg.title: mike startup and shutdown, animated
svg.desc: Animated boot log of mike serve: fast paths, subcommand dispatch, config and tracing, AppState::new, the pre-bind startup sequence, the Postgres LISTEN task, 27 background worker entry points with their default work gates, observability tasks, binding ports 9988, 9989 and 9990, the signal handler, serving, and a SIGTERM shutdown with graceful shutdown starting at 3s, a 10s serve deadline and a 60s hard backstop.

g.text: bare mike: TTY → TUI · no TTY → serve
config::loaddefaults < config file < MIKE_* env < CLI
spawn_background_workers27 calls; spawn-time or work gates
SOME OF THE 27 WORKERS · DEFAULT WORK GATES
SHUTDOWN DEADLINES, FROM THE CANCEL SIGNAL
main() answers the version, build-info and fleet hook invocations before Cli::parse(); it reads no .env.
A bare mike opens the TUI on a TTY and serves headless otherwise. mike serve always serves.
Boot config is a figment chain. The runtime source of truth for toggles is /settings.
Initializes persistence when configured and builds the in-memory store, channels, task tracker and shutdown token.
Startup sequence, before any port binds
Loopback warnings, crash recovery, build identity, bundle retry, session sweep, mailbox reload and warmup.
Recovery is attempted before listeners bind; a recovery failure is logged and boot continues.
This task later turns every capture write into a live /api/ws event.
Some gates prevent spawning; others disable work inside a running task. Defaults assume dependencies.
OpenRouter paths are opt-in; embedding and database destinations are configured separately.
The cap manager sheds load in priority order past the RSS high-watermark; with rss_ceiling_bytes = 0 it only observes.
:9988 and :9989 always bind; :9990 only when spa_enabled (start-proxy.sh hands it to vite dev instead).
SIGHUP counts too: a closed controlling terminal shuts mike down cleanly.
The proxy and inspect binds each run a real axum::serve; the SPA slot is a no-op future when disabled.
Axum begins graceful shutdown 3s after cancellation; the serving join has a 10s deadline from cancellation.
Task waits are capped at 30s each; the process has a 60s hard backstop. Timing here is illustrative.
OTel is flushed last. The next boot starts with crash recovery, in case this exit was not clean.
